en.headline: 379 own commits across 16 repos, focused on OpenCode skills and tooling
en.teaser: Two weeks of skill and plugin development (meld-deepresearch, sopen-translate, opencode-skill-management) plus a steady stream of OpenCode and OpenChamber bug reports.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-25 with no gaps: every one of the 30 days carries data. Total activity was 379 commits, 8 pull requests and 53 issues; no reviews were submitted. In addition to the 379 own commits there were 513 automated commits, mostly the self-updating activity-card workflow in the profile repository.

### Skill development as the main thread

The centre of gravity was a family of OpenCode skills. `meld-deepresearch` went from a single research skill to a small cooperating family, releasing v0.1.0, v0.2.0, v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 in quick succession. v0.2.0 turned the handling of paywalled and bot-walled sources into an explicit rule, logging blocked pages as observations with HTTP status and labelling thinly supported claims `unknown`; the validator now also returns fix hints. v0.3.0 split the work into three cooperating skills (core research, spreadsheet analysis, and a third capability skill) with hard delivery gates. v0.4.0 added a thin `meld.py` wrapper around the six gate scripts and downgraded some gates, making re-runs safer. Alongside this came a bilingual GitHub Pages landing page with light and dark themes, English and Chinese READMEs, and M1–M3 milestone scripts and CI.

`sopen-translate` was started from scratch: MV3 skeleton, a providers protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, plus smoke tests, a page-state reset fix and JSDoc-based `checkJs` type checking. Selection translation was dropped in favour of page translation only.

`opencode-skill-management` shipped a `skill_management` plugin with `list`, `inspect`, `disable` and `enable` actions that work purely by writing permission rules into the global config rather than touching skill files; it was released as rc.0, rc.1, v0.2.0 and finally v1.0.0, with the rc.1 run used to validate CI trusted publishing over OIDC. `opencode-go-model-picker` released v1.1.0, v1.3.0 and v1.4.0, restructuring the output into a three-part body plus data appendix and adding `discover-agents.mjs` and `snapshot-summary.mjs`; the later release added an agent-discovery inventory, `mode`/`hidden`/`traits` fields, `skippedBuiltins` reporting, BOM-tolerant atomic JSON helpers and proxy re-execution for the network scripts. `asset-inventory` released v1.14.0, v1.15.0 and the patches v1.15.1 through v1.15.3: one-line install via skills.sh, a workflow-first SKILL.md, a registry-first host-command scan with an id completeness guard, and a move of mode routing and table rules into references.

### Agent, sandbox and knowledge work

`opencode-agent-sandbox` was created and grown into a documentation base: AGENTS.md, a `knowledge/` directory for Git, GitHub and OpenCode findings (V2 distribution, architecture, auth, Windows path pitfalls), plus corrections to outdated conclusions about subcommand lists, bundled skill counts, Windows ports and remote branch deletion. The profile repository `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` received most of its work in automation: a 30-day activity card, a daily report moving to rolling two-hourly updates with a manual date input, English copy throughout, a peak/average chart summary, statistics that can no longer disagree with their breakdown, checkout/setup-node upgrades to v7, and `.gitattributes` enforcing LF.

### Upstream bug reporting

highlights.text: v0.2.0 hardened the research protocol: blocked sources are logged with HTTP status, and claims supported only by unreachable sources are labelled unknown.
v0.4.0 wrapped the six gate scripts behind a single meld.py with prepare, render, review and verify subcommands.
v1.0.0 froze the skill_management surface for 1.x, disabling skills by writing one permission rule instead of editing skill files.
v1.4.0 added mod/hidden/traits fields and skippedBuiltins reporting to discover-agents.mjs and made all four network scripts respect a proxy.
v1.15.0 made the host-command scan registry-first, with an id completeness guard so different field ordering cannot hide entries.
Reported that the context panel breakdown bar divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input, so 其他 always reads 0%.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image with a 400.
fix: harden eval robustness in parsing, aggregation, and install — opened 2026-09-28 and closed 2026-10-01.

zh.headline: 16 个仓库 379 次本人提交，重心是 OpenCode 技能与工具
zh.teaser: 两周集中在技能与插件开发（meld-deepresearch、sopen-translate、opencode-skill-management），同时向 OpenCode 与 OpenChamber 提交了一批缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-09-26 至 2026-10-25，30 天全部有数据，没有缺失日期。总量为 379 次提交、8 个拉取请求、53 个议题，未提交评审。除 379 次本人提交外，另有 513 次自动提交，主要来自个人主页仓库中自动更新的活动卡片工作流。

### 技能开发是主线

最集中的工作是 OpenCode 技能家族。`meld-deepresearch` 从单一研究技能扩展为多个协同技能，连续发布 v0.1.0、v0.2.0、v0.3.0 和 v0.4.0。v0.2.0 把付费墙与机器人拦截页面的处理写成明确规则：被拦页面按观察记录 HTTP 状态，仅有不可达来源支撑的结论标记为 `unknown`，校验器同时给出修复提示。v0.3.0 拆分出核心研究、表格数据分析等三个协同技能，并加上交付硬门禁。v0.4.0 用 `meld.py` 把六个门禁脚本收进一个入口，并下调部分门禁以降低重跑风险。期间还加入双语 GitHub Pages 落地页（明暗主题）、中英 README，以及 M1–M3 的脚本与 CI。

`sopen-translate` 从零搭建：MV3 骨架、带预设的 provider 协议层、模型列表与术语表流水线、分块的双语页面渲染、熔断器与进度显示，并补充冒烟测试、页面状态重置修复和基于 JSDoc 的 `checkJs` 类型检查；最终去掉划词翻译，只保留整页翻译。

`opencode-skill-management` 交付 `skill_management` 插件，通过向全局配置写入权限规则实现 `list`、`inspect`、`disable`、`enable`，从不改动技能文件；依次发布 rc.0、rc.1、v0.2.0，最后到 v1.0.0，其中 rc.1 用于验证 CI 的 OIDC 可信发布。`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布 v1.1.0、v1.3.0、v1.4.0，把输出重构为三段正文加数据附录，新增 `discover-agents.mjs` 与 `snapshot-summary.mjs`；后续版本补上代理清单、`mode`/`hidden`/`traits` 字段、`skippedBuiltins` 报告、容忍 BOM 的原子 JSON 辅助函数以及网络脚本的代理重执行。`asset-inventory` 发布 v1.14.0、v1.15.0 以及 v1.15.1 至 v1.15.3 的补丁版本：skills.sh 一行安装、工作流优先的 SKILL.md、注册表优先的宿主命令扫描与 id 完整性校验，并把模式路由和表规则移入 references。

### 智能体、沙箱与知识沉淀

`opencode-agent-sandbox` 从初始提交起步，逐步建成文档库：AGENTS.md、记录 Git/GitHub 与 OpenCode 发现的 `knowledge/`（V2 分发、架构、认证、Windows 路径坑），并修正了子命令列表、随包技能数量、Windows 端口和远程分支删除等过期结论。个人主页仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的工作几乎都在自动化上：30 天活动卡片、日报改为每两小时滚动更新并支持手动指定日期、全英文文案、峰值/均值图表摘要、统计数字与拆分不可能对不上、checkout/setup-node 升级到 v7，以及用 `.gitattributes` 强制 LF。

### 上游缺陷报告

相当一部分精力用于上游缺陷报告，OpenChamber 最多：引用卡片箭头在引用消息不在已加载历史中时静默无效、跨行号拖拽评论不稳定、自动发现开发服务器误跑首个已保存动作、上下文面板拆分条中「其他」恒为 0%、200% 缩放下浏览器截图只有 1 倍分辨率、智能体关联的议题/PR 无法解除关联、跳过角色提示把两段回复合并成一轮、切换模型时思考等级不重置，以及 Go 配额面板显示 Provider not configured。同一仓库还发起了多个 Ideas 讨论。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 上报告了 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 在一次会话超过五张图后读到旧图、子智能体报 `model_coming_soon`、Go 端点拒绝其宣称支持的图片输入，以及 Windows 桌面自带 CLI 却无法运行等问题。`antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 有四个修复 PR：插件卸载时释放评审服务器、技能 frontmatter 校验接受 CRLF、按平台命令打开评审链接、加固评测解析与聚合的健壮性；另有两个议题涉及 dist 重建内联依赖与 V2 插件加载失败。较小规模的上报覆盖 OfficeCLI（技能安装路径指向 `~/.opencode` 而 OpenCode 实际用 `~/.config/opencode`）、SenseNova-Skills、SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch 和 oh-my-opencode-slim（会话发现仍查询旧 V1 表）。

### 其他说明

`myBlog` 只新增了三张 OpenChamber 截图素材。本人账号下的 `opencode-skill-creator` 有 5 次自动提交、无本人提交。数据质量方面，2026-09-26 至 2026-10-01 的日期经 GitHub Search 回填，该段数据为近似值，星数不可用，发布信息仅覆盖本人仓库。

v0.4.0 用 meld.py 把六个门禁脚本收进 prepare、render、review、verify 等子命令。
v1.0.0 冻结 skill_management 的 1.x 接口，禁用技能只需写入一条权限规则而不改动技能文件。
v1.4.0 为 discover-agents.mjs 增加 mode/hidden/traits 字段与 skippedBuiltins 报告，并让四个网络脚本都遵循代理。
v1.15.0 把宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先，并加入 id 完整性校验，避免字段顺序不同而漏掉条目。
报告上下文面板拆分条用整会话估算除以最后一条消息输入，导致「其他」恒为 0%。
